courses.summary: 以礦山與選礦廠連至遠端精煉廠的鋰鏈為案例，研究產品與公用資源界面。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A lithium chain linking mine and concentrator to a remote refinery examines product and utility interfaces. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
